column2:
En[kidu — before you ever came from your hills,]
a+2'	al[ready Gilgameš, inside Uruk, was seeing you in dreams.]
Gilgameš [lay down and saw a dream;]
he rose to unra[vel it to his mother:]

The [stars of the sky] came out for me;
a+6'	a lump of the sky-rock of Anu [fell down at me.]
a+7'	I tested it: [it was too heavy(?) for me;]
a+8'	I shoved at it: [I could not] budg[e it.]
a+9'	The land of Uruk was gather[ed about it;]
a+10'	the young men, massed, could no[t heave it up;]
a+11'	I set my brow to it; they b[raced with me;]
a+12'	I lifted it up and carried it [to you.]
The mother of Gilgameš, who kn[ows everything, unravels(?) it,]

See now, Gilgameš — one who is [like your very self]
a+16'	was born on the open land, and [the steppe(?)] is rais[ing him;]
a+17'	his might is as ha[rd] as a lump of the sky-rock of Anu.
a+18'	Because I shall make him equal with y[ou,]
a+19'	they did not know him, and they gather [about him;]
a+20'	the young men kiss the feet of that o[ne;]
a+21'	you will see him, and your heart will rejo[ice;]
a+22'	you will hug him and lead [him to me.]
Gilgameš [lay down] and sa[w a dream;]
[he rose to unravel it] to [his] mothe[r.]
